payload.text: which --json version 1 is agreed: vc's yes with three changes (rank null for unknown; resets_at as the endpoint gives it, cut to the second; headroom as cc defines it) and cc's yes with three meanings (headroom in percent of the weekly allowance, under --model the lesser with the scoped window's share; scoped entries carry share; soonest among accounts not unknown). The final shape is in vc's inbox from ic, with one clarification open to objection: percent and resets_at report what the data says, and state and cause say whether the rule could use it.
